reason: The controlled real acceptance must remain non-replayable even if the Chat turn or Companion execution is interrupted after owner authorization.

capabilities.reason: This hardens the already documented gated Topnet acceptance candidate; canonical capability truth is unchanged.

architecture.reason: The existing private gate file is consumed atomically; no new storage, daemon, scheduler or execution owner is introduced.

rollback: Remove this one-shot hardening only before any live acceptance. After any engaged payment, preserve guard state and verify the effect instead of replaying.
limitations: This gate is for the single controlled Topnet acceptance only.
Issuer-required bank authentication remains a human boundary.
